## Architecture guardrails (archfit)

- Before a cross-module import: `archfit policy can-import -c ts-monorepo.archfit.yaml <file> <target>`. `denied` names the rule and what to do instead; `unconstrained` is not permission.
- Before you finish: `archfit check -c ts-monorepo.archfit.yaml --format agent`. Follow `next_action`; `change.status: pass` is a correct finish, even with exit code 2.
- Module owner, layer, allowlists and rules for a path: `archfit policy where -c ts-monorepo.archfit.yaml <path>`.
- At session start, or when unsure the hooks run: `archfit doctor`.
- Never edit `ts-monorepo.archfit.yaml`, `.archfit-baseline.json` or `.archfit-labels.yaml`, and never add a waiver, to make a check pass.
- `ask_owner` or `change.status: unknown`: stop, report the rule and what you need, and ask the architecture owner.
<!-- archfit:end -->
